test_compile_regions: test that compile_regions compiles transformer layers and lm_head as separate optimized modules
test_extract_model_keep_torch_compile: test extract_model_from_parallel with keep_torch_compile true preserves the original compiled model reference
test_extract_model_remove_torch_compile: test extract_model_from_parallel with keep_torch_compile false returns the unwrapped original model
test_regional_compilation_cold_start: test that regional compilation has a faster cold start than full model compilation
test_regional_compilation_inference_spee: test that regional compilation inference speedup is similar to full compilation speedup
